headline: Teacher Aide
summary: Education graduate waiting for my licensure results and looking for a teacher aide post. During practice teaching I helped manage a Grade 4 class, prepared materials and kept attendance and grade records in order. Patient with children and organised with paperwork.
skills: Assisting teachers with activities and materials

experience.title: Practice Teacher
bullets: Helped the cooperating teacher manage a Grade 4 class of 42 and supervised group work.
Kept daily attendance and encoded quiz results into the class record.
